title: Peter Schiff Mortgage Bankers Speech Nov/13/06
summary: Peter Schiff's November 2006 speech to the Western Regional Mortgage Bankers Conference, in which he warned an audience of mortgage bankers that the housing bubble would collapse. The clip runs about 73 minutes.
why: HN cites it as a famous example of someone publicly predicting the housing crash before it happened.

quote.text: The best whistle blowing before the bubble popped had to be Peter Schiff
